replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Gameplay:
 + Map is quite small but seeing the 8v8 player count makes it look like it could work without bigger issues.
 + Interesting layout
 + Looks like a good amount of cover is provided
 + I am guessing the water tunnels act like spawn timers. With a map this size they might be needed and seeing them implemented is great.
 - Cobblestone walls could become really annoying
 - The corridors (pic 2) could use some work. I feel like the coal blocks take away a lot of room
 - If the ladders at the water tunnels (which I assume is spawn) are the only way out of spawn, it might lead to spawn camping.

Aesthetic:
 + I really like the use of the hay but I wish there were more blocks to go with it.
 - The dirt / brick / clay combo does not mix in that well. Dirt sticks out quite a bit. I have mixed feelings on using podzol
 - I don't think the leaves really work on this map
 - The glass panes on the sides stick out quite a lot. I'd experiment with some colored glass panes in neutral colors such as gray

Other:
 - Lack of food. Happens on a lot of maps. I recommend 16 steak just so players don't run out.
